holder-quote: The words were fitting, and the Order of Seasons echoed her. But Ser Solstice, the Goblin Slayer, Rabbiteater, gazed at Talia.
Rabbiteater was good—but he was a [Champion], good at fighting.
effect-quote: the Spring’s Warden saw the cut coming and moved her sword out of the block; he’d have slashed through her practice sword otherwise.

holder-quote: He carved towards her blade, and she stepped back
effect-quote: He carved towards her blade, and she stepped back—and returned back as his sword missed her.
